sources.title: Explore the searches that are Trending now

Displayed search volume is bucketed traffic; these are not YouTube views.

access_probes.detail: Tool returned URL not safe to open (non-retryable error); no page inspected.
Tool returned Unsupported content-type: text/xml. RSS body and fields were not read; no local collector execution occurred.
One attempted browser selection returned No browser is available. Export menu and exact menu target not inspected. Parent had earlier observed this missing-browser condition; no further CUA retry.

verification_limit: Official help confirms RSS export. The inferred fixed RSS URL produced an XML content-type response, but its menu link and XML body have not been inspected in these probes. A separately logged bounded collector call must verify actual access and fields.
